$comment: What the SDK schema cannot say about the Swift side of each generated CmuxNextDaemon request type (swift_app/emit.py explains the rules). A family is one Requests/<Family> folder; it moves here from hand-written Swift in one change.

Layout.$comment: new-row stays hand-written in Layout/NewRowRequest.swift: it carries the shared SpawnOptions and moves with the Creation family.

doc: The neighbor a viewport column trades places with (`move-column`).
A direction from a pane: a split's side, a swap's or a focus move's neighbor.

move-column.name: MoveColumnRequest
doc: Moves the whole viewport column holding `pane` (every pane, split and row in it) one place left or
right (`column-move-v1`). The daemon refuses a column at the strip's edge or next to a docked column
(`column-move-edge`) and a docked column (`column-move-docked`).
Any pane of the column that moves.

set-column-dock.name: SetColumnDockRequest
doc: Pins the column holding `pane` to a viewport edge, or unpins it (`dock-columns-v1`). One docked
column per edge: the daemon unpins a column already on that edge, and refuses to leave no column
scrolling. `role` needs `dock-column-role-v1`; an older daemon ignores it. Build it from a
`DockSnapshot` with `init(pane:dock:pinned:transaction:)`.
`pinned-dock-v1`: true marks the column pinned (the Home dock); nil keeps what the column has (the
daemon never clears a pin).

set-row-heights.name: SetRowHeightsRequest
doc: `set-row-heights` (`rows-v1`): every row of one column at once. `fit` requires a sum of exactly 1000.

set-split-ratio.name: SetSplitRatioRequest
doc: Divider drag. Reuse one `transaction` per gesture so undo coalesces.

set-viewport-pane-width.name: SetColumnWidthRequest
doc: Column width drag (`viewport-column-resize-v1`). Reuse one `transaction` per gesture so undo coalesces.
The share of the viewport the column takes.

swap-pane.name: SwapPaneRequest
doc: Trades `pane` with its neighbor in `dir` or with the pane `target`; exactly one of them. Build it
from a `SwapTarget` with `init(pane:target:)`.

undo-layout.name: UndoLayoutRequest
doc: Undoes the last layout change of `pane`'s screen. An undo that closes panes first answers
`confirmation_required`; send it again with that `revision` and `confirmClose` to apply it.
